recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add core elements or extensions for this issue without a separate work-group decision; remaining data-representation questions belong in Patient Care discussion or IG guidance.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification PA request to clarify RelatedPerson for birth-defect reporting use cases involving parents who may be deceased or otherwise not participating in patient care.
initial_application: The FHIR-25727 resolution points to the related FHIR-30313 health-scope update, and git commit 81f8b30cb34e87c76cffca4218d55c7c48d53799 states it covered FHIR-25727 while changing the RelatedPerson definition.
additional_context: The 2022 PA WGM minutes discussed FHIR-25727 immediately before FHIR-30313 and treated them as related scope trackers. Later FHIR-41566 and FHIR-41559 changed adjacent boundary wording but did not narrow the health-scope clarification.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current RelatedPerson source already allows the broader class of people involved in a patient's health.
